title: Info
subtitle: How to play, the words you'll see, and what ACARS is.

nostr.title: Decentralized on Nostr
nostr.desc: All game state lives on the Nostr protocol — no central database, no single point of failure. Your airline is yours.

realtime.title: Real-Time Aviation Sim
realtime.desc: Flights resolve in real-world time. A 7-hour transatlantic route takes 7 real hours. Manage your fleet like a live ops dashboard.

bitcoin.title: Bitcoin & Lightning
bitcoin.desc: On the roadmap: earn real sats through prize pools and Zaps, and trade airline stock peer-to-peer on Lightning. Not in the game yet.

acarsDesc: ACARS (Aircraft Communication Addressing and Relay System) is a fully open-source, decentralized airline management MMO built on the Nostr protocol.

howTo.title: How to play
steps: Pick a route from your hub: Routes → Opportunities, or tap a city on the map. Launch it — the plane is leased for you.
Wait for delivery (a few minutes), then the plane flies on its own, in real time, even while you're away.
Every landing earns money. Check in now and then: the cockpit shows the last 24 hours and what needs you.
Fill seats: adjust fares and flights a week on each route. Changes to a route already on sale start at 00:00 UTC.
Grow: more routes and planes, a day plan to keep each plane busy, a second hub. Open routes and revenue unlock the next tier.
Rival players fly the same map for the same passengers. Get ranked, compare on Rivals, or form an alliance.

glossary.title: Words you'll see
items: The share of seats sold on your flights (airlines call it load factor).
A plane's chain of legs, flown at the same UTC times every day. Without one, a plane flies one route back and forth.
Your airline's size class. It unlocks longer routes and bigger planes.
A one-time proof that keeps throwaway airlines from dumping fares; ranked airlines appear in the ranking.
Two airlines that name each other: passengers connect across both networks.
